title: Wipe slide
description: Directional wipe from one scene to the next: the arriving scene is revealed by a moving clip-path edge with an ease-in-out curve.
props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*20*/; direction?: 'left'|'right'|'up'|'down' /*'left'*/}
example:
import {WipeSlide} from './blocks/wipe-slide/WipeSlide.tsx';
<WipeSlide from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} durationInFrames={20} direction="left" />
